fixtures.expectation: PackageId, PackageRevisionId and canonical DefinitionId remain distinct semantic identity domains.
Only normalized exact and caret v1 requirements are accepted.
Highest compatible non-revoked candidate is selected deterministically.
One PackageId cannot resolve to two exact revisions.
Runtime authority is the exact ResolutionLock and never a floating range.
Revoked candidates are not silently selected.
Optional dependencies require explicit fallback semantics.
Optional conflict cannot perturb a required exact revision.
Failed optional transitive subtree leaves no leaked selections.
Lazy dependency is exact-locked before deferred materialization.
Dependency depth is independently bounded.
Resolved package count is independently bounded.
Catalog rows are independently bounded.
Solver decision work is independently bounded.
Aggregate exact locked bytes are independently bounded.
SPB1 fixed framing and deterministic-CBOR index are required.
SPB1 index is pathless and closed; extraction metadata is not representable.
SPB1 payload is tightly packed with no overlap, gaps or trailing chaff.
Digest or length substitution is rejected before semantic activation.
Serialized grants, tokens, host/session handles and install authority are recursively rejected.
Parent and dependency components use distinct principals and grants do not inherit.
Definition promotion preserves DefinitionId and public PortId lineage.
Public interface changes require explicit reconciliation.
Migration/Behaviour work cannot run until physical and manifest validation completes.
Failed update leaves previous exact lock and live state coherent.
Verified immutable cache supports exact offline reuse but never changes semantic resolution.
Protected Asset revision is complete and cross-revision field mixing is rejected.
Source metadata, provenance, licence/attribution, remix policy and derivation lineage round-trip separately from trust.
Unsupported required package or artifact features fail with typed incompatibility.
Package artifact set, kinds, sizes and digests match the validated manifest exactly.
A same-count dependency tuple cannot substitute a different PackageRevisionId for the manifest-declared exact child edge.
Every locked child human version must satisfy the parent manifest requirement before migration or execution.
Optional dependencies declared transitively by selected package manifests are resolved as isolated extensions or use their fallback without perturbing the hard closure.
Lazy acquisition is allowed only when every selected incoming dependency edge is lazy, independent of traversal or catalog order.
